info.description: Personal finance API for accounts, transactions and budgets
info.title: Kopiika API

get.description: Reports that the process is serving requests. Checks no dependencies.
Reports that the process is alive. Always 200 while the server is up, so a failure means the process should be restarted.
Reports whether the service can serve traffic, verifying the database and the task queue's Redis connection. Returns 503 when a dependency is unavailable.
List the authenticated user's accounts. Pages are cut by creation order; within a page accounts are ordered by their localized amount, richest first

post.description: Create a new account for the authenticated user

get.description: Every account the authenticated user holds plus their combined worth in the user's own currency, richest first
Get one of the authenticated user's accounts by id

put.description: Update one of the authenticated user's accounts. Only the fields present in the payload are changed; currency and balance cannot be set this way

delete.description: Soft delete one of the authenticated user's accounts. Idempotent.

get.description: List the authenticated user's own categories together with the global defaults, ordered by id. Unpaginated

post.description: Create a new category owned by the authenticated user

put.description: Update one of the authenticated user's own categories. Only the fields present in the payload are changed; global default categories are never updatable

delete.description: Soft delete one of the authenticated user's own categories. Idempotent, and global default categories are never deletable

get.description: List the authenticated user's transactions grouped by the day they happened on, newest day first. The page is cut by day rather than by transaction, so total counts days and one page can hold any number of transactions

parameters.description: Matches anywhere in the title, case-insensitively
parameters.name: search

put.description: Update one of the authenticated user's transactions, identified by the id in the body. Every field is replaced, so an omitted description, category or account clears it. The date cannot be changed. Balances are rebalanced, including when the transaction moves between accounts

post.description: Create a transaction for the authenticated user. When it names an account, the account's balance moves with it: income adds the value, outcome subtracts it, and the transaction currency must match the account's

get.description: Get the categories the authenticated user may label a transaction with and the accounts they may post it to, in one response. Tags are not ported and come back as an empty array
Get everything the authenticated user spent or earned on one day. Answers null for a day with no transactions
Get the authenticated user's most recent transactions, newest first by the day the money moved

Report on everything the authenticated user recorded between two days, inclusive, in their own currency. Every transaction is converted at the rate for its own date rather than today's. Without full, only the income, outcome and difference totals, the per-day series and the category spending breakdown are populated; the remaining fields hold their zero values so the response shape does not change

parameters.description: Also report the counts, averages, extremes and account breakdowns
parameters.name: full

get.description: Get one of the authenticated user's transactions, with its category and account attached

delete.description: Soft delete one of the authenticated user's transactions, taking its effect back off the account balance. Idempotent: a repeat delete does not move the balance again

post.description: Create the local configuration for the authenticated Cognito user, deriving the starting language and currency from the country code. Idempotent.

parameters.description: Country the defaults are derived from
parameters.name: payload

get.description: Get the currently authenticated user's configuration, optionally with the identity provider's profile attached

parameters.description: Attach the identity provider's profile block. Costs one call to the user pool
parameters.name: profile

put.description: Update the authenticated user's language and default currency

localizedAmount.description:
LocalizedAmount is Amount converted into the user's own currency, so a
client can total accounts that are denominated differently.

previousPeriodDiff.description:
PreviousPeriodDiff is this figure minus the same figure over the
comparable previous period, in the same currency. Positive means it grew.

hexColor.description:
HexColor is spelled this way, rather than the accounts colorHex, because
that is the key the existing clients send and read.

value.description:
Value is a pointer so that a missing value is rejected while an explicit
zero is still accepted, as in Python.

localizedAmount.description:
LocalizedAmount is Amount converted into the user's own currency at the
rate for the transaction's own date, not today's.

tags.description:
Tags is always empty: tags are not ported yet, and the key is kept so the
response shape stays the one the clients already read.

title.description: Title and Description are what the user typed, not a derived label.

tags.description:
Tags is always empty: tags are not ported yet, and the key is kept so the
response shape stays the one the clients already read.

categoryOutcomeStatistics.description:
CategoryOutcomeStatistics is spending per category, largest first.
Transactions with no category are left out rather than pooled.

minIncome.description:
MinIncome and MaxIncome are the smallest and largest single income of the
range, compared on the localized amount. They are null when the range
holds no income at all.

rangeStatistics.description: RangeStatistics covers every day in the range, oldest first.

transactionsPerDay.description:
TransactionsPerDay is how many days of the range carried any activity,
divided by the number of days between its two ends. It is a rate, not a
count, and it is reported as a string like every other number here.

externalProvider.description:
ExternalProvider is the federated identity the user signed in through, and
is null for a user who signed up with a password.

profile.description:
Profile is filled in only when the request asks for it, because filling it
in costs a call to the user pool.
